title: Pan-Seared Barramundi with Vietnamese Curry Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the delicate flavor of barramundi with the bold spices of Vietnamese curry sauce.
instructions: Season the barramundi fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the barramundi fillets and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the barramundi from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the barramundi to the skillet and spoon some of the curry sauce over the top.
Simmer the sauce for 1-2 minutes, or until heated through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and scallions, and serve immediately.
